default.description: Default capability for the AvatarOS main window. Allows core default permissions; the custom set_ignore_cursor_events command is registered via generate_handler! and callable by default. http:default is scoped to local Ollama and the listed cloud LLM vendors (DeepSeek / Aliyun Bailian / Moonshot / Zhipu / Volcengine Ark); add a URL here to use another vendor.
